purpose: Narrow OMS-005 from generic overseas local service into an evidence-bound industrial field microtask hypothesis, then attack it with incumbent and closure searches.

candidate.named_demand_actor: 徐州鹏程电气有限公司 / Xuzhou Pengcheng Electric Co., Ltd.
candidate.demand_actor_location: 徐州 / 邳州, 江苏
observed_recent_event: At the 2026 Kenya power/energy/water exhibition, a Kenyan PV/water EPC representative physically measured interfaces on Pengcheng equipment and agreed a follow-up operating-condition test.
Pengcheng publicly stated the next step is local condition testing and adaptation for East African climate/power-use conditions.
current_internal_service_model: Pengcheng's public service page states that, after warranty, it can send professionals for component replacement and installation.
Public product/service material says large-equipment installation, commissioning and onsite technical service are provided by the company.
A current energy-storage engineer role includes site survey, SAT testing, grid commissioning, fault diagnosis, delivery acceptance, O&M support and short-term travel.
observed_partial_flow: The Kenya exhibition connected Pengcheng to two local renewable-energy agents and one local PV/water EPC.
Jiangsu trade-promotion authorities explicitly emphasize post-exhibition follow-up to convert exhibition traffic into orders and long-term cooperation.

callable_supply_pool_observed.name: Central Electricals / other licensed Kenya contractors

incumbent_search: Field-service management SaaS products already digitize global work orders, engineer dispatch, onsite evidence and service history.

Field Nation / OnsiteBro / Field Engineer and local East Africa marketplaces show the general on-demand technician model already exists, though many focus on IT or generic trades rather than manufacturer-specific industrial electrical tasks.
Industrial service-partner firms such as Klose/Veritek/Industrial Marvels already sell outsourced overseas field-service capability to OEMs in selected regions.

Malaysia/Jiangsu business organizations are explicitly building domestic-demand-to-overseas-execution service channels; Xuzhou leaders such as XCMG and 海伦哲 already operate mature local service/agent networks in Malaysia.
candidate.narrowed_missing_edge_hypothesis: For mid-sized equipment exporters that have overseas demand but cannot justify owned local service infrastructure, there may be a residual between generic local contractors and OEM-grade field work: one bounded manufacturer-defined onsite task executed by a licensed local provider, with remote OEM escalation, white-label/brand rules, evidence capture, acceptance criteria and settlement.
exact_candidate_task_units: one diagnosis + evidence-capture visit before deciding whether OEM travel is necessary

rooter_execution_map.actor_a: Xuzhou/Jiangsu equipment exporter with one bounded overseas field task
rooter_execution_map.partial_flow: agents/EPCs, trade-show introductions, local contractors, OEM engineer travel and remote support already coexist
rooter_execution_map.missing_edge: unproven: whether OEM-specific task specification, acceptance, liability, brand representation and settlement remain materially unsolved after current agents/EPCs
rooter_execution_map.acceptance: OEM-defined checklist + timestamped evidence + measurements/test data + remote expert sign-off where needed
rooter_execution_map.payer: equipment exporter or overseas buyer, depending warranty/contract terms
rooter_execution_map.money_flow: payer -> orchestration/QA layer -> local licensed provider
rooter_execution_map.operator_role: task schema, provider qualification, routing, remote-OEM coordination, evidence/acceptance, settlement and reputation data
rooter_execution_map.operator_non_role: do not travel to site; do not become the electrical engineer; do not assume unlicensed technical liability
rooter_execution_map.exit_path: standard task templates + qualified provider graph + acceptance history + automated routing

reachability.demand_side_evidence: public phone/email/address and current active recruiting/export activity
reachability.supply_side: C/UNASSESSED for current operator because providers are overseas and no exact commercial relationship is bound

mobilization_recheck.explanation: Real demand direction and real supply exist, but value capture and self-propulsion are not evidenced; current agents/EPCs may already solve the exact route.

strongest_counterevidence: Pengcheng already connected to two local agents and one EPC in Kenya.
Direct local licensed contractors are publicly discoverable, so search alone may not create enough orchestration value.
Outsourced field-service partner models already exist globally.
For some markets, local-partner networks are already the standard service configuration.
kill_conditions: Pengcheng's existing Kenya agents/EPC can already perform site survey, field testing, commissioning and post-sale onsite work under Pengcheng's required standards at acceptable cost/time.
A local contractor can be directly engaged with trivial search/coordination and no material trust/acceptance problem.
The only residual is generic lead generation or introduction.
Legal/liability/qualification requirements force the operator into high-permission technical responsibility.
promotion_conditions: A named exporter provides a recent case where an OEM engineer had to travel, a job was delayed, or a customer waited because the existing local agent/EPC could not complete one bounded field task.
The task is repeated across more than one exporter or installation.
A qualified local provider is willing to execute under OEM-defined task/acceptance rules.
There is measurable economic room between current workaround cost and local-provider payout.
The route can repeat without the founder doing per-task sales or delivery.

malaysia_counter_scan.conclusion: Do not promote generic China-Malaysia local-service routing merely because operator fit is attractive.
evidence: 海伦哲 already operates with a Malaysian official agent and authorized service stations.
XCMG has mature Southeast Asia local service points, parts inventory and service engineers.
Malaysia Jiangsu Entrepreneurs Business Association explicitly describes building a systematic platform/channel between Jiangsu demand and Malaysia execution resources.
malaysia_counter_scan.residual_search_target: small, infrequent, cross-brand, acceptance-sensitive field tasks that mature agent/service networks and general landing-service platforms do not economically serve

scan_conclusion.material_change: OMS-005 is no longer a vague overseas-service idea. It is narrowed to an OEM-defined industrial field microtask hypothesis with a named Xuzhou actor, real recent overseas field-testing event, real local capability pool and explicit closure test.
scan_conclusion.current_best_next_truth: Continue public search for one exporter case proving that an existing agent/EPC/local contractor failed to economically complete one bounded field task, causing OEM engineer travel, delayed acceptance, extended downtime or another measurable residual. Without that, close the route as already-served.
